visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black hair and a blue zip-up hoodie featuring a white graphic sits indoors at a table. He gestures with his hands while looking at the camera. Two packs of Extra gum, one blue and one yellow, are positioned on the table in the foreground. The setting appears to be a living room with a brown leather sofa and warm overhead lighting. (2) The man holds a black tablet showing a manga illustration of a person drawing. White and pink text overlays the image. The camera stays static. (3) A close-up series shows pages of an old book with sketches of human eyes and various metal pen nibs labeled with letters like 'G' and 'D'. The pages are aged and yellowed. (4) The man holds up a small metal pen nib and then a dip pen holder. He dips the pen into a bottle of black ink on the table. The lighting is bright and even. (5) The man draws on a piece of brown parchment paper. A sketch of a woman reaching out to a running boy is shown. The drawing is minimalist and line-based. (6) A screen recording shows a mobile messaging app with a blue sky background. Text bubbles appear sequentially. A profile picture of the man is visible in one bubble. (7) A black-and-white close-up shot of the man's face captures a distressed expression with wide eyes. Digital rain effects are overlaid on the frame. (8) The man pours white gum pellets from a blue Extra bag into his hand. He puts one in his mouth and chews. (9) He leans back on the sofa, eyes closed, with a digital white circle and blue stars rotating around his head. (10) The scene shifts to a different room filled with anime figurines and boxes. The man shows a tablet displaying a modern, colorful digital illustration of a cat-girl lying in bed. (11) A fast-paced montage shows the digital coloring process of a new drawing: black lines are filled with color. (12) The final drawing is displayed: a stylized character with cat ears, black hair, a blue top, and yellow shorts, lying down next to a glass of tea. (13) The man is back on screen holding several packs of Extra gum, smiling and pointing at them. (14) Large yellow and pink text overlays the screen. Graphic slides appear showing various Extra gum products and a promotional offer with the FamilyMart logo.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The narrator begins with an enthusiastic, medium-pitched voice. A light, upbeat acoustic guitar BGM plays underneath. (2) A sharp 'ding' sound effect puncturates the speech as a tablet is shown. (3) A rapid paper-rustling sound occurs with a high-frequency transient. (4) A 'swoosh' transition sound with a wide spectral sweep follows a scene cut. (5) Multiple digital 'pop' and 'click' UI sounds signal messaging notifications, with high-frequency emphasis. (6) A dramatic shift occurs: a low-frequency thunder rumble and minor-key piano chord accompany a B&W visual. Vocal tone shifts to exaggerated distress. (7) A rattling sound of gum pieces hitting a plastic bag is heard. (8) A high-pitched 'sparkle' SFX with long decay plays as digital graphics appear. (9) The music shifts to a high-tempo J-pop track with female Japanese vocals and heavy electronic percussion. (10) A synthesized 'meow' sound effect triggers a transition. (11) Rapid, high-arousal speech resumes over a bouncy commercial synth BGM with a strong, 4/4 electronic beat.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Conflict -> Climax/Solution -> Result -> Promotion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous narrative about learning to draw via an ancient manual to promote Extra sugar-free gum as a tool for mental relaxation and regaining focus ('good state'). The failure of the 'ancient' method is contrasted with a 'modern' success enabled by chewing gum.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of the product, naming the brand, and a final segment dedicated to a price promotion at FamilyMart.
